spans.text: 1 Which of the following statements are true or false?
a Bandwidth determines how much data can be sent in a fixed timeframe.
b The higher the bandwidth, the more data can be sent at a time.
c Low bandwidth networks transmit data at the same speed as high bandwidth transmission media.
d Bandwidth is expressed as packets per second.
e The number of users and devices connected to a network affects the total bandwidth.
f Some activities on a network require more bandwidth than others.
2 Explain how bandwidth affects the speed of data transmission.
3 Explain how the number of devices on a network affects the bandwidth.
a Text and images stored in a computer are examples of digital content.
b Live events such as a concert cannot be streamed.
c Streaming involves storing the entire file from a server to your computer.
d A video that is being streamed can be viewed almost instantly.
e Podcasts and audio books are two types of audio digital content stored on servers that are streamed.
f Servers can store and send messages.
g A wireless router converts data from the internet into radio waves.
h Radio waves are referred to as RW.
i Only smartphones can access Wi-Fi signals.
j A Wi-Fi adapter acts as a transmitter and a receiver.
k Radio waves travel through the air.
l Digital devices use their built-in receivers to pick up Wi-Fi signals.
m Lots of information can be sent using Wi-Fi signals.
n Cellular networks also use radio waves to send and receive data.
2 Name two types of video content stored on servers that can be streamed.
